seller_list: Lea & Sandeman live In Bond Bordeaux, 50 distinct wine/vintage/format lines (59 rows, 54 In Bond, deduped)

price_spreads_seen.note: Vinum names it Premier Grand Cru Classe B so identity is confirmed; Albany is 91% above L&S - the widest gap in the set and a real test for the band check

identity_traps.trap: Albany's 'Louis Latour Chevalier Montrachet Les Demoiselles' 2020 matched the token 'chevalier' for Domaine de Chevalier - a Burgundy white at GBP 2,300 against a Bordeaux red at GBP 230, a 10x error. Caught at eye verification; B09 now requires 'domaine'+'chevalier' and excludes 'montrachet'.
Farr labels one row 'Lagrange (St Julien)' - the parenthetical is the only thing separating it from Chateau Lagrange in Pomerol.

Second wines sit adjacent to grand vins in every catalogue: Aile d'Argent and Petit Mouton (Mouton), Le Petit Smith Haut Lafitte, La Clarte de Haut Brion, La Croix de Beaucaillou, Reserve de Leoville Barton. All handled by required/excluded tokens.
